heard: You don't need AI to find the best GTA 6 clips, chat already found them.
When something crazy happens on stream, chat explodes, hundreds of messages in 10 seconds.
So I had Claude build me a tiny tool, one file, free.
A free app downloads the stream's chat. My tool counts it every 10 seconds.
finds the spikes, and cuts each one into a vertical clip.
The trick, chat reacts late, so every clip starts 20 seconds early.
One command, a whole folder of clips.
GTA 6 drops Thursday, 6-hour streams everywhere, you won't have to watch a single one.
comment, chat, and I'll send you the tool and the setup guide.
